## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behaviour. Link the learning issue or roadmap package.

## Validation

List relevant checks and evidence. For a learning task, include the concept explanation and a changed-input demonstration.

## Review

- [ ] Targets `master` from a task branch.
- [ ] Published history was preserved without force-pushing.
- [ ] Inherited local materials and sensitive data are excluded.
- [ ] Any material limitations are stated.
